gather.name: Miner
gather.text: Mines 2 crystals from a mine it stands next to (Fighters mine 1).

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.text: It can be summoned any time onto any empty space next to any mine.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.text: +1 Attack when next to another Goblin.

ranged.name: Ranged
ranged.text: Hits the first unit up to 7 spaces away in a straight line (8 directions). Cannot shoot past a unit. No strike back.

kaboom.name: Ka-boom
kaboom.text: When defeated, deals 2 damage to all adjacent enemies.

sneaky.name: Sneaky
sneaky.text: Enemies cannot strike back at it.

haste.name: Haste
haste.text: Can act the turn it is played.

fixit.name: Fix-it
fixit.text: At the start of your turn, each adjacent ally gets Shield 1.

armored.name: Armored
armored.text: Takes 1 less damage from every hit.

blink.name: Blink
blink.text: Once, swap places with any of your creatures.

overload.name: Overload
overload.text: Its attack also hits every enemy next to the target for 1.

guard.name: Guard
guard.text: Adjacent enemies must attack it first.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Can move and attack in the same turn.

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.text: Never takes more than 3 damage from one hit.

heartyale.name: Hearty Ale
heartyale.text: At the start of your turn, each adjacent ally gets +1 Health until your next turn.

eaterGuzzler.name: Crystal Eater
eaterGuzzler.text: Each extra Crystal card you play this turn deals 2 damage to it.

eaterConduit.name: Crystal Eater
eaterConduit.text: Each extra Crystal card you play this turn means it can't move or attack until your next turn, and it loses 1 Health.

eaterDelver.name: Crystal Eater
eaterDelver.text: Each extra Crystal card you play this turn gives it -1 Attack for the rest of the match.

smith.name: Smith
smith.text: Summon it as a Miner, or play it on one of your own creatures for a permanent +1 Attack or +1 Health.

kaboom1.name: Ka-boom 1
kaboom1.text: When defeated, deals 1 damage to every adjacent enemy creature.

junkBoost.name: Junk Boost
junkBoost.text: On your turn, adjacent Goblins get +1 Attack.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.text: When it defeats a creature, your Bank gets +1 crystal.

glyphShield.name: Glyph Shield
glyphShield.text: At the start of your turn it gets Shield 1.
